title: 1953 AHSME Problem 19
statement: In the expression \(xy^2,\) the values of \(x\) and \(y\) are each decreased \(25\%;\) the value of the expression is:

solutions.text:
The new value is \[ \left(\frac34x\right)\left(\frac34y\right)^2 =\frac{27}{64}xy^2. \] Therefore the decrease is \(1-\frac{27}{64}=\frac{37}{64}\) of the original value.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Each decreased variable is \(\frac{3}{4}\) of its original value
Account for the two powers of \(y\) when finding the new multiplicative factor
